input_template:
Attempted operation and expected result: ...
Error text or recent review verdicts: ...
Complete attempt history, fixes, and outcomes (explicitly first attempt if applicable): ...
Caller-established authorization and remaining retry budget: ...
Required delay and evidence it has elapsed: ...
Replay safety, side effects, and known completion state: ...

questions.name: failure_kind
questions.instructions: Before classification, the caller must establish authorization, a remaining retry budget, any required delay, and replay safety. Require the complete attempt history, including an explicit first attempt when applicable. Choose insufficient_evidence if these prerequisites are missing, conflicting, or unmet. A timed-out write with unknown completion requires diagnosis, never automatic replay. Reserve transient_capacity_or_timeout for positive evidence of a temporary condition and a safe bounded retry without code changes. A timeout alone does not establish a transient cause or replay safety. Do not assume a deterministic defect is transient. Classification never grants authorization.

choices.description: Evidence supports a temporary condition and the caller has established a safe, authorized, bounded retry.
Evidence shows a test intermittently fails on unchanged code.
A code or logic defect needs correction before another attempt.
Missing credentials, tools, configuration, or prerequisites prevent the operation.
The cause, history, or caller-established retry prerequisites are missing, conflicting, or unmet.

questions.name: looping
questions.instructions: Does the supplied attempt or review history show the same underlying problem recurring across rounds despite retries or patches? An explicitly documented first attempt is not a loop. Missing history does not establish the absence of recurrence.
